rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the TPM-only, 6v6 unpaired design and routes it to TPM-native absolute (quanTIseq TIL10, EPIC with tumor=TRUE) and score-based (MCP-counter, explicitly not summed to one) methods with non-log input, Wilcoxon per cell type with BH, a stated exploratory alpha, sample_01 retained with a sensitivity re-run, and stacked bars of fractions. Gaps against the reference: the QC never reports the share of signature genes present in the 12000-gene matrix and lacks any sample-structure view (PCA/distances); the group comparison reports only direction and adjusted p, not the difference of group means beside it; method versions are not named; and the caution that a fraction is an estimate contingent on the reference is only implicit. Running six methods adds bulk without adding rigor, but nothing planned is wrong (no log matrix into EPIC/quanTIseq, no cross-population MCP comparison, no CIBERSORT portal).
